newsitem.title: CHINA: CASIL Telecom says to offer shares at HK$1.18 each.
newsitem.headline: CASIL Telecom says to offer shares at HK$1.18 each.

text.p: CASIL Telecommunications Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was issuing 150 million shares at HK$1.18 per share in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
CASIL is a unit of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd.
The issue price represents a proforma price/earnings multiple of 9.83 times on a fully-diluted basis, it said.
The issue represents 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, giving a market capitalisation of HK$708 million.
The IPO will run from July 29 to August 1, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on August 11, it said.
Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd is the sponsor and lead underwriter.
CASIL Telecom develops, makes and sells telecommunications switching equipment and global positioning systems (GPS).
The GPS business is operated by wholly owned CASIL GPS Engineering Ltd.
"This IPO offers investors the chance to invest in a high-tech multinational conglomerate," CASIL chairman Wang Mei Yue said in a statement.

The company forecast a combined profit after tax and minority interests but before exceptional items of not less than HK$72 million for the year ended Decembher 31, 1997. It gave no comparative figures.
